source_reconstruction: Checkout the base Git commit, then overlay the archived src/ files. The archive also retains the exact pre-evaluation proof, protocol and evaluator. Unchanged source remains recoverable from Git.
evaluation: One evaluation of the unchanged frozen analytic contact protocol after archiving its proof, inputs, evaluator and exact runtime source overlays. Current-source regression tests are separate evidence and do not replace the saved response.
scope: Actual unprobed formation-to-contact receiver discrimination with both whole-family winding identities retained under the supplied positive-loss law. Contact work, preparation, relative origin and support remain supplied. No physical observation or trajectory sampling.
provenance_limitations: Hashes establish content consistency and source recoverability, not independent authentication of chronology or physical acquisition.
